rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is difficult or hard to do.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 hou2 naan4

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that a task has a significant level of difficulty.

example.english: Finishing this plan within a month is challenging.
example.traditional: 要喺一個月內完成呢個計劃，真係有難度。
example.jyutping: jiu3 hai2 jat1 go3 jyut6 noi6 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 jau5 naan4 dou6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the task or problem is difficult to deal with or manage, rather than merely time-consuming.

example.english: This computer problem is challenging to deal with.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 din6 nou5 man6 tai4 hou2 naan4 gaau2
